operations.acquire: CAS an unowned task and allocate the next fencing token
operations.heartbeat: CAS the exact owner, lease, token and strictly advance time and expiry
operations.handoff: atomically replace an unexpired owner and allocate the next token
operations.recover_expired: atomically replace only an expired owner and allocate the next token
operations.release: CAS the exact owner and clear ownership before expiry

invariants: At most one owner is committed for a task revision.
Every acquire, handoff, and expiry recovery strictly increases the fencing token.
Every mutation uses the exact current task revision as a compare-and-swap.
Heartbeat time and expiry are strictly monotonic for the current owner.
An old owner, lease, or token cannot mutate state after replacement or recovery.
An operation ID is idempotent only for the identical request and changed replay is rejected.
Ambiguous or delayed responses remain unknown until the same operation ID is replayed or delivered.

interleavings.schedule: fixed round-robin with crash, delay, replay and expiry windows
